arguments.summary: Investigated the p99 latency spike and the failed jobs backlog. Pgbouncer in the prod namespace was restarted as the connection pool was exhausted, leading to a worker throughput of 0. Exported the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Next steps include reviewing pgbouncer configuration and investigating the root cause of the failed jobs.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Review pgbouncer configuration and investigate the root cause of the failed jobs.
